purpose: Choose one mechanism-independent deterministic Alpha158 state factor for Campaign290 without reading Alpha158 feature values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_median_state_persistence_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A deterministic temporal Hamming-persistence score is directly computable from the already frozen Alpha158 development design and is mechanism-distinct from Campaign289's supervised random-hyperplane hash buckets.

parameters.state_anchor: same-session finite model-support-peer median per coordinate
parameters.lag: exactly one accepted local trading session

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_median_state_transition_breadth_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The complement of the selected persistence score would be a deterministic sign inversion rather than an independent trial; alternate direction search is forbidden.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_session_quantile_state_persistence_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Tercile, quartile and quintile cut grids create an avoidable threshold family; Campaign290 freezes the single median state system.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_multi_lag_state_persistence
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Lag search would multiply trials and blur the exact previous-session hypothesis.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_weighted_state_persistence
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Coordinate weighting would introduce return-fitted or arbitrary weights; all 158 coordinates remain equal weight.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_cosine_similarity_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Raw-scale similarity is sensitive to heterogeneous Alpha158 coordinate units and would require an extra scaling family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign289_hash_retune
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign289 bit count, seed, hyperplanes, support, fallback, costs and gates are terminal and cannot be rescued or retuned.

selected_formula.name: alpha158_session_median_state_persistence_1d
selected_formula.formula: For each accepted signal session t and each of the frozen 158 Alpha158 coordinates j, compute the exact finite median m_tj over rows with model_support_eligible=true on t. Encode each finite supported row as -1 when x_tij<m_tj, 0 when x_tij=m_tj and +1 when x_tij>m_tj. For the same stock i on exactly the immediately preceding accepted session p, require model support on both p and t; among coordinates finite on both sessions, require at least 119 and score the number with identical encoded state divided by the paired-finite count. Do not bridge suspensions, missing rows or unsupported sessions; do not fill, clip, smooth, weight, fit or invert.
selected_formula.economic_hypothesis: Broad persistence of a stock's relative technical state may proxy for slow information diffusion and continuation from the next open through the third close.

mechanism_separation.campaign289: No random hyperplanes, hash cells, supervised cell means, seed, bucket support or fallback are used.
mechanism_separation.campaign103: Campaign103 counts directional rank improvement over a 130-factor historical library; Campaign290 compares exact three-state equality across 158 Qlib technical coordinates.
mechanism_separation.day_over_day_profile_factors: Campaign290 compares a broad daily technical state vector rather than raw intraday amount or return-profile shapes.
